text: おれは　おとな　だから　がっつかないのさ　レッドから　さきに　えらばせて　やるぜ！

structure.jp: おれは　おとな　だから

structure.en: I don't get greedy, you see

structure.jp: レッドから　さきに　えらばせて　やるぜ！
structure.en: I'll let you choose first, Red!

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending means letting or making someone do the action. えらばせて = 'letting you choose'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる says you do something as a favour for someone you look down on; it sounds cocky. えらばせて　やる = 'I'll let you choose'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because' or 'so'. おとな　だから = 'because I'm a grown-up'.
